snippet.title: 鬼壓床 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703480/_/

Is a first-person perspective horror game, adapted from the producer's personal experiences and real-life events, with the story set in Tainan in 2005. Through the gaming experience, it aims to help players who have never experienced ghost pressing bed understand the fear associated with it.

Developed by 
KID
